sections.title: The full paradigm
sections.content: fog conjugates like an ordinary verb across all six persons — no surprises once you know fogok, fogsz, and fog from before. Whichever person you use, the main verb after it stays the same bare infinitive.

items.english: Next week we will work a lot.

items.spanish: Ildikó és Gábor jövő héten fognak nyaralni.
items.english: Ildikó and Gábor will go on holiday next week.

sections.content: Same rule as always: only fog carries the person and number. The infinitive at the end — dolgozni, utazni, nyaralni — never changes, no matter how many people are doing it.
